messages.sampleCatalogNotice: Virtual store with illustrative merchandise. Real merchant inventory and checkout are not connected.
messages.aiSearchLabel: Use AI to understand my request

messages.aiSearchUsed: Selected for your request, with details from this store's catalog.

messages.catalogSearchUsed: Catalog keyword search. AI was not used.
messages.noProvider: Find products, compare catalog details, and keep a saved list on this device.
